lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ጐይታኳ’ዩ ነዚ ዝገበረ
ኣምላኸይ’ዩ ንዅሉ ዘስመረ
ኣብ ምሉእ ዘመነይ ድንቂ ዝፈጸመ
ጐይታኮ’ዩ ነዚ ዝገበረ
[[/chorus]]

ውዲት ጸላእየይ ዘፍረሰ ንሱ’ዩ
ካብ ምውጋራ ብእምኒ ዘድሓነኒ ፈልዩ
ኣዋጅ ሞት ስዒሩ ጽድቂ ዘልበሰኒ
ኣምላኸይ ጥራሕ’ዩ ዝኣባበደኒ
ጐይታኮ’ዩ ሓጢኣተይ ስዒሩ
[[highlight]]ጐይታኮ’ዩ ሓጢኣተይ[[/highlight]] ሰላም ኪድ ዝበለ
[[highlight]]ጐይታኮ’ዩ ሓጢኣተይ[[/highlight]] ንልበይ ኣቕሲኑ
[[highlight]]ጐይታኮ’ዩ ሓጢኣተይ[[/highlight]] ትካዜይ ዘጥፍአ

ዝተበጀወኒ ካብ ኣእዳው ሸፋቱ
ዝዘነነለይ’ውን ኣቑሳለይ ብዘይቱ
ፈታውየይ ኮይኑ ዘጸናንዓኒ
ጐይታየይ ንሱ’ዩ ደበስ ዝኾነኒ

ጐይታኮ’ዩ ብምሕረት ጠሚቱ
[[highlight]]ጐይታኮ’ዩ ብምሕረት[[/highlight]] ዝፈወሰ ቑስለይ
[[highlight]]ጐይታኮ’ዩ ብምሕረት[[/highlight]] ካብ ጸር ኣናጊፉ
[[highlight]]ጐይታኮ’ዩ ብምሕረት[[/highlight]] ዝኾነ ሰላመይ

ባሕሪ ተሳጊሩ ዝመጸኒ ንዓይ
ብሕይወት ዝቐየረ ንናይ ሙታን ናብራይ
ንዝኣሰረኒ ብስሙ ገሲጹ
ናጻ ኣውጺኡኒ ታሪኸይ ለዊጡ
ጐይታኮ’ዩ ንልበይ ዘቕሰነ
[[highlight]]ጐይታኮ’ዩ ንልበይ[[/highlight]] ኣቦ ዝኾነኒ
[[highlight]]ጐይታኮ’ዩ ንልበይ[[/highlight]] ጸላኢ ስዒሩ
[[highlight]]ጐይታኮ’ዩ ንልበይ[[/highlight]] ቤቱ ዘንበረኒ

ኣብ ድንኳን መሳኪን ኣትዩ ዝቕመጥ
ምጽንናዕ ዝህብ ሓዘን ንዝውሓጥ
ኣዝዩ ለዋህ ጐይታ ምድሓኑ ረኣና
ንስሙ ወድሱ ብዕልልታ ምስጋና
ጐይታኮ’ዩ ካብ መቑሕ ፈቲሑ
[[highlight]]ጐይታኮ’ዩ ካብ[[/highlight]] ንዎት ዘስገረና
[[highlight]]ጐይታኮ’ዩ ካብ[[/highlight]] ኣብ ሰልፊ ኣበርቲዑ
[[highlight]]ጐይታኮ’ዩ ካብ[[/highlight]] ኵሉ ዘቕንዓልና
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Goytakwa’yu nezi zigebere
ʾAmlakhey’yu nikhulu zesmere
ʾAb miluʾi zemeney dinqi zifetseme
Goytako’yu nezi zigebere
[[/chorus]]

Widit tselaʾiyey zefrese nisu’yu
Kab miwgara biʾimni zedhaneni felyu
ʾAwaj mot siʿiru tsidqi zelbeseni
ʾAmlakhey t'irah’yu ziʾababedeni
Goytako’yu hat'iʾatey siʿiru
[[highlight]]Goytako’yu hat'iʾatey[[/highlight]] selam kid zibele
[[highlight]]Goytako’yu hat'iʾatey[[/highlight]] nilbey ʾaqhsinu
[[highlight]]Goytako’yu hat'iʾatey[[/highlight]] tikazey zet'fiʾa

Zitebejeweni kab ʾaʾidaw shefatu
Zizeneneley’win ʾaqhusaley bizeytu
Fetawyey koynu zetsenanʿani
Goytayey nisu’yu debes zikhoneni

Goytako’yu bimhiret t'emitu
[[highlight]]Goytako’yu bimhiret[[/highlight]] zifewese qhusley
[[highlight]]Goytako’yu bimhiret[[/highlight]] kab tser ʾanagifu
[[highlight]]Goytako’yu bimhiret[[/highlight]] zikhone selamey

Bahri tesagiru zimetseni niʿay
Bihyiwet ziqheyere ninay mutan nabray
Nizʾasereni bismu gesitsu
Natsa ʾawtsiʾuni tarikhey lewit'u
Goytako’yu nilbey zeqhsene
[[highlight]]Goytako’yu nilbey[[/highlight]] ʾabo zikhoneni
[[highlight]]Goytako’yu nilbey[[/highlight]] tselaʾi siʿiru
[[highlight]]Goytako’yu nilbey[[/highlight]] betu zenbereni

ʾAb dinkwan mesakin ʾatyu ziqhmet'
Mitsninaʿi zihb hazen nizwihat'
ʾAzyu lewah goyta midhanu reʾana
Nismu wedsu biʿillita misgana
Goytako’yu kab meqhuh fetihu
[[highlight]]Goytako’yu kab[[/highlight]] niwot zesgerena
[[highlight]]Goytako’yu kab[[/highlight]] ʾab selfi ʾabertiʿu
[[highlight]]Goytako’yu kab[[/highlight]] kulu zeqhniʿalna
